Definition: a (sea-going) vessel (as ceiled with a deck)
BiblicalUsage: Sephinah is a sea-going ship, and it appears once, in the storm that chased Jonah. The mariners were afraid and threw the wares out of the ship to lighten it, while Jonah slept below.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ship matters because it shows how far a man will run — and that no ship outruns God.
